title: AFTERIMAGE — Articulated shoulder and waist jewelry for live performance, 14 deliverables

config.text:
# AFTERIMAGE — client facts

## Production
- Production name: AFTERIMAGE.
- Descriptor: Echo in motion.
- Context: independent live stage work for an adult performer.
- Theme: a visual echo carried through accessory form and movement.
- Set: one shoulder assembly S with left and right parts; one waist assembly W.
- Production name and descriptor locations: materials and craft note, performance hero, presentation cover.

## Performer and starting costume
- Stature: 1700 mm.
- Shoulder breadth: 400 mm.
- Natural-waist circumference: 760 mm.
- Dimension basis: supplied design-scale dimensions.
- Performer identity, gender and ethnicity: open.
- Existing costume: plain black sleeveless unitard in performer-base.png.
- Costume image: front and back schematic views with unlabeled attachment regions.
- Accessory scope: shoulder assembly S and waist assembly W.
- Costume continuity: existing unitard appearance throughout the applications.

## Attachment regions
| Label | Body-relative location | Assembly |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SL | Left shoulder top | S |
| SR | Right shoulder top | S |
| WL | Left lateral natural waist | W |
| WR | Right lateral natural waist | W |
| WB | Center back waist | W |

- Attachment-region count: 5; all five in use.
- Left/right convention: the performer's own left and right; screen positions reverse between front and back views.
- Garment interface: reinforced textile regions.
- Closure options: compatible textile loops, ties or releasable closures.
- Detailed closure mechanism: design decision.
- Body support locations: SL and SR for S; WL, WR and WB for W.
- Visually open movement areas: face, neck and armpits.
- Rigid accessory location: outside the body and garment.

## Form and articulation
- Design character: original jewelry with a coherent echo silhouette.
- Minimum moving decorative elements: 1 on the left shoulder, 1 on the right shoulder, 1 on W.
- Articulation: identifiable joints or flexible connections, fixed parts, moving parts and intended paths.
- Motion options: rotation or lag of connected moving parts.
- Continuity across poses: stable component identities, counts and connections.
- Concealed moving connections: joint/path insets.

| Assembly | Extension direction | Maximum in every pose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| S | Outward beyond either shoulder | 100 mm |
| W | Outward from waist body surface | 80 mm |
| W | Below natural waist | 200 mm |

- Chosen maximum envelopes: design decisions within the three limits.
- Numerical dynamic clearance, joint force and retention rating: unspecified.

## Materials
| Material | Allocation |
| --- | --- |
| Anodized aluminum | Structural and decorative metal |
| Translucent PET sheet | Optional light-catching elements |
| Woven textile tape | Flexible connections |
| Silicone | Body-facing pads where closures need them |

- Structural and decorative palette: the four materials listed above.
- Sheet and tape thicknesses: design decisions.
- Colors, surface finishes and joint details: design decisions.
- Material continuity: fixed component allocation across poses and lighting cues.
- Lighting response: directional reflections and transmitted color may change with illumination.

## Movement cues
| Cue | Body orientation | Arm position |
| --- | --- | --- |
| P0 | Front-facing neutral stance | Arms down |
| P1 | Front-facing | Arms extended sideways at shoulder height |
| P2 | Turned approximately 45 degrees to the performer's right | Both arms extended forward at shoulder height |

- Cue source: motion-cues.png.
- Cue type: static pose illustrations.
- Pose-board lighting: neutral rehearsal light.
- Assembly presence: S and W attached in P0, P1 and P2.
- Motion-study duration: 10 seconds.
- Motion-study sequence: P0–P1–P2–P0.
- Motion-study lighting: neutral rehearsal light.
- Inter-pose movement and articulated lag: design development between the supplied pose cues.

## Lighting cues
| Cue | Main light | Fill |
| --- | --- | --- |
| L1 | Warm amber from the front | Soft neutral fill |
| L2 | Cool blue rear/side rim | Dim neutral front fill |

- Two-light comparison: left L1, right L2.
- Comparison constants: P0 pose, camera framing, accessory geometry and material allocation.
- L2 edge treatment: moving edges separated from the dark background by rim illumination.
- Performance hero: full-body view of S and W over the existing unitard under L2.
- Stage architecture and audience: optional scene context.
- Atmosphere reference: stage-light-atmosphere.png.

## Dressing and prototype rehearsal
- Dressing sequence: attachment of S and W at the five named regions, followed by closure engagement.
- Removal sequence: release and removal of S and W before unitard removal.
- Release actions: one identified action for each assembly.
- Prototype rehearsal topics: dynamic retention, movement clearance and skin/edge contact.
- Presentation length: at least 8 pages.

# AFTERIMAGE — delivery catalog

This table lists every commissioned deliverable with its tier, file format and stage. What each deliverable must contain is stated in the commission letter.

| # | id | Deliverable | Tiers | Format and stage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | materials-craft-note | Materials and craft note | 14 | Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: process. |
| 2 | silhouette-anchor-board | Silhouette and anchor board | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 3 | shoulder-assembly | Shoulder assembly S design board | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 4 | waist-assembly | Waist assembly W design board | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 5 | connection-board | Attachment and connection board | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 6 | material-board | Component material board | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 7 | pose-p0 | P0 neutral stance board | 14 | Format: PNG, 1200 by 1800 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 8 | pose-p1 | P1 lateral arm extension board | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 9 | pose-p2 | P2 right-turn forward reach board | 14 | Format: PNG, 1200 by 1800 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 10 | two-light-board | L1 and L2 lighting comparison | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 11 | dressing-board | Dressing and removal sequence | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 12 | performance-hero | AFTERIMAGE performance hero | 14 | Format: PNG, 1200 by 1800 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 13 | motion-study | Ten-second articulated motion study | 14 | Format: video; 5 to 15 seconds. Stage: final. |
| 14 | presentation | AFTERIMAGE design presentation | 14 | Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final. |

steps.userMessage:
AFTERIMAGE | Articulated shoulder and waist jewelry for live performance

We are commissioning a coordinated body-jewelry set for AFTERIMAGE, an independent stage work in which a performer's gestures leave a visual echo. The set consists of one shoulder assembly S with left and right parts and one waist assembly W. The adult performer is 1700 mm tall, with shoulder breadth 400 mm and natural-waist circumference 760 mm. The existing plain black sleeveless unitard is the costume foundation. Our fixed starting point is jewelry whose articulated elements continue the line of a gesture: at least one moving decorative element on each shoulder and one at the waist. Develop this direction through a materials and craft note before drawing the applications. Print the production name as "AFTERIMAGE" and the descriptor as "Echo in motion" on the note, the performance hero and the presentation cover.

S attaches at SL and SR, the performer's left and right shoulder tops; W attaches at WL and WR, the lateral natural waist, and WB, the center back waist. These five reinforced textile regions take the loops, ties or releasable closures you design. S has a maximum outward extension of 100 mm beyond either shoulder; W has a maximum extension of 80 mm from the waist body surface and 200 mm below the natural waist, in every pose. Keep the face, neck and armpit movement visibly clear. The material palette is anodized aluminum, optional translucent PET sheet, woven textile tape for flexible connections and silicone for body-facing closure pads. Establish thicknesses, colors, finishes and joint details in the opening note. The movement sequence is P0, front-facing with arms down; P1, front-facing with arms extended sideways at shoulder height; and P2, turned approximately 45 degrees to the performer's right with both arms extended forward at shoulder height. Lighting cue L1 is warm amber from the front with soft neutral fill; L2 is cool blue rear/side rim light with dim neutral front fill.

Audience: the adult performer, choreographer and costume workshop, for selecting the set's appearance, reviewing its movement logic and planning prototype rehearsals.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md records the performer dimensions, attachment regions, materials, movement cues and lighting conditions. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every deliverable's proportion, format and stage. performer-base.png is the identity image for the existing unitard and its front and back appearance. motion-cues.png is the constraint image for P0, P1 and P2. stage-light-atmosphere.png is the reference image for dark-stage atmosphere and the contrast between frontal illumination and rim light.

Deliverables:
1. A one-page materials and craft note recording the echo concept, metal and flexible materials, chosen thicknesses, colors, finishes, joint types, attachment regions and the three extension limits
2. One silhouette and anchor board with front, back and side views, chosen maximum extensions dimensioned within the 100 mm, 80 mm and 200 mm limits, and all five body-relative attachment labels
3. Two assembly design boards, one for S and one for W, with front and back views, component identifiers, fixed and moving parts and joint-path diagrams
4. One connection board detailing SL, SR, WL, WR and WB, the reinforced textile interfaces, closure engagement and the release action for each assembly
5. One material board mapping the note's materials, thicknesses, colors and finishes to the identified components of S and W
6. Three separate pose boards, one each for P0, P1 and P2 in neutral rehearsal light, with extension guides and joint/path insets for concealed connections
7. One two-light board with matched P0 panels, L1 on the left and L2 on the right
8. One dressing board showing the sequence for attaching S and W at all five regions, engaging their closures and releasing both assemblies before removing the unitard
9. One full-body performance hero showing S and W together over the existing unitard under L2, carrying AFTERIMAGE and Echo in motion
10. One 10-second motion study following P0 to P1 to P2 and back to P0 in neutral rehearsal light, with the articulated elements visible throughout
11. One presentation document of at least 8 pages, reusing the note, assembly drawings, connection details, material board, pose studies, lighting comparison and dressing sequence

Acceptance:
- Record anodized aluminum, the selected flexible materials, the five attachment labels and the 100 mm, 80 mm and 200 mm limits in the materials and craft note. Repeat its material and finish assignments on the material board and in the presentation; repeat its extension limits on the silhouette and anchor board and in the presentation.
- Label SL and SR for S and WL, WR and WB for W on the silhouette and anchor board, assembly design boards, connection board and dressing board. Use the performer's own left and right in front and back views, and connect the jewelry through the five reinforced textile regions of the existing plain black sleeveless unitard.
- Carry the assembly design boards' component identifiers, counts and connections into all three pose boards and the motion study. Depict at least one moving element on each shoulder and one on W; use visible joints and path insets to track them. Show the 100 mm shoulder, 80 mm waist-outward and 200 mm waist-down limits on every pose board, with the face, neck and armpit movement clear and rigid pieces outside the body and garment.
- Match pose, camera framing, geometry and material allocation between the two-light board's left L1 and right L2 panels. Show warm frontal illumination in L1 and a distinct cool rim along moving edges in L2; carry the material board's assignments into both panels and the L2 performance hero.
- Show closure engagement at all five regions and an identified release action for each assembly on the connection and dressing boards. Order the dressing board's removal steps with S and W detached before the unitard, and list dynamic retention, movement clearance and skin/edge contact as prototype rehearsal topics in the materials and craft note and presentation.
- Print AFTERIMAGE and Echo in motion on the materials and craft note, performance hero and presentation cover. Give the motion study a duration of 10 seconds and the sequence P0–P1–P2–P0; give the presentation at least 8 pages incorporating all seven groups of earlier work named in its deliverable.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
